title: HAAY KARBALA WAALO
body:
Aye Khuda ke bando'n me muntakhab Khuda waalo
Takht e Innama waalo taaje hal ata waalo
Shaan e Mustafa waalo waz e Murtaza waalo
Kya wafa pe jaane dee tumne aye wafa waalo
<<MINI>>
Haay Karbala Waalo, Haay Karbala Waalo
<<DIVIDER>>
Chhote chhote bachcho'n ne jang ki ijaazat li
Badgaye jawa'n bankar kamsini se rukhsat li
Qaom ki himaayat me Izzat e Shahadat li
Zindagi ko kya kahiye maot se bhi khidmat li
<<MINI>>
Haay Karbala Waalo, Haay Karbala Waalo
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis bala ke jangal me Aal e Mustafa thahri
Bedayaaro ka madfan arze Karbala thahri
Aayi Shaame Aashura sub'ha ko wegha thahri
Kya khabar Madina ko Shaamiyo'n se kya thahri
<<MINI>>
Haay Karbala Waalo, Haay Karbala Waalo
<<DIVIDER>>
Haq pa marne waalo ne jaan di saleeqe se
Shaoq se tamanna se azm se iraade se
Zindagi na ki pyaari Fatima ke Pyaare se
Maa ki godh se aaya koi koi jhoole se
<<MINI>>
Haay Karbala Waalo, Haay Karbala Waalo
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi Tum me Akbar tha koi Tum me Asghar tha
Koi Saaniye Jaafar koi misle Hyder tha
Koi qadro qeemat me dojahan se bartar tha
Zere tegh Karbal me Fatima ka gharbhar tha
<<MINI>>
Haay Karbala Waalo, Haay Karbala Waalo
<<DIVIDER>>
Is tarah ke aalam me phir na dil jigar dekhe
Dar pa aake Maao'n ne jang ke hu'nar dekhe
Apne Chaand ke tukde khu'n me tarbataar dekhe
Rege garm par Laashe barchhiyo'n pa sar dekhe
<<MINI>>
Haay Karbala Waalo, Haay Karbala Waalo
author: Najm Aafandi
